journeyObjective: Provide frictionless visibility into cashback earnings, points balance, statement credit redemption options, and payment-linked goal progress.
entryPoint: Customer opens rewards overview to check cashback and statement credit allocation.
completionDefinition: Customer views points balance, cashback summary, and reviews statement credit options without encountering irrelevant voucher prompts.

miniJourneys.customerQuestion: What is my current points and cashback balance?
How do my points convert to bill reduction and how is automatic allocation set?
What is my progress toward my payment-linked savings goals?
miniJourneys.entryCondition: Customer has reviewed statement credit options and allocation

supportingSurfaces.purpose: Provide educational context on how statement credits work and how automatic payment allocation saves time.
contentNotes: Educational guidance on bill reduction rates and cash equivalency.
